question:
13. (i) In the identity
\[
\frac{n!}{x(x+1)(x+2)\cdots(x+n)}=\sum_{k=0}^{n}\frac{A_k}{x+k},
\]
prove that
\[
A_k=(-1)^k\binom{n}{k}.
\]

(ii) Deduce that:
\[
\binom{n}{0}\frac1{1\cdot2}-\binom{n}{1}\frac1{2\cdot3}+\binom{n}{2}\frac1{3\cdot4}-\cdots+(-1)^n\binom{n}{n}\frac1{(n+1)(n+2)}=\frac1{n+2}.
\]

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10 + 2 Level
